en.name: Pull-Up
setup: Grip the bar with palms facing away, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Hang with straight arms and brace your core.
execution: Pull your shoulder blades down, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Lift until your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself all the way to straight arms.
mistakes: Kicking or swinging to get up.
Stopping short of straight arms at the bottom.
Reaching the chin forward instead of lifting the chest.

en.name: Barbell Row
setup: Hold the bar with an overhand grip just outside your knees.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is at about 45 degrees or lower.
Keep your back flat and knees softly bent.
execution: Pull the bar to your lower ribs, driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the bar until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Standing up more with every rep.
Jerking the weight up with the hips.

en.name: Lat Pulldown
setup: Set the thigh pad so your legs are locked in.
Grip the bar wider than your shoulders with palms facing away.
Sit tall with a slight lean back.
execution: Pull the bar down to your upper chest while driving the elbows down.
Pause, then let the bar rise until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck.
Leaning far back and turning it into a row.
Letting the weight yank the arms up.

en.name: Seated Cable Row
setup: Sit at the row station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle with straight arms and sit tall.
execution: Pull the handle to your belly while keeping your torso still.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Let the handle go forward until your arms are straight and your shoulders reach.
mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth.
Rounding the back at the front of the rep.

en.name: Chin-Up
setup: Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Hang with straight arms and brace your core.
execution: Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to straight arms.

en.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
setup: Place one knee and the same hand on a bench.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your arm straight.
Keep your back flat and parallel to the floor.
execution: Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping the elbow close.
Lower it until your arm is straight and the shoulder stretches.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to lift the weight.
Pulling toward the chest instead of the hip.

en.name: Dumbbell Shrug
setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Let your arms hang straight with palms facing in.
execution: Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold the top for a second, then lower slowly.

en.name: Barbell Shrug
setup: Hold the bar in front of your thighs with an overhand grip just outside your hips.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
execution: Shrug your shoulders straight up as high as you can.
Pause, then lower the bar slowly.
mistakes: Using a bouncing motion with the knees.

en.name: Back Extension
setup: Set the pad just below your hip bones and hook your heels under the foot pads.
Cross your arms over your chest or hug a plate for extra load.
execution: Lower your torso by bending at the hips until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
mistakes: Arching far past straight at the top.
Setting the pad so high that the hips cannot bend.

en.name: T-Bar Row
setup: Load one end of a barbell set in a landmine and straddle it.
Hook a V-handle under the bar near the plates.
Hinge until your torso is about 45 degrees, back flat.
execution: Pull the handle to your chest, driving the elbows back.
Lower until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Using the legs to heave the weight.

en.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
setup: Attach a V-handle and sit with your thighs under the pad.
Hold the handle with palms facing each other.
execution: Pull the handle to your upper chest while leaning back slightly.
Let it rise until your arms are straight.

en.name: Machine-Assisted Pull-Up
setup: Set the assistance weight; more weight makes it easier.
Kneel or stand on the platform and grip the handles.
execution: Pull your chest up toward the handles.
Lower yourself slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Using so much help that the reps are effortless.
cues: Full range, less help over time

en.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with knees soft.
Keep your back flat with the dumbbells hanging under your shoulders.
execution: Row both dumbbells to your hips.
Lower them until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Standing more upright as the set goes on.

en.name: Machine Row
setup: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your lower chest.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grip the handles.
execution: Pull the handles back until your elbows pass your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then return slowly.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad.

en.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
setup: Set a bench to a low incline and lie face down on it.
Let a dumbbell hang from each hand under your shoulders.
execution: Row the dumbbells up until your elbows pass your torso.
Lower them until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench.
Curling the weight with the biceps.

en.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
setup: Attach a straight bar or rope to a high pulley.
Step back, hinge slightly and hold the bar with straight arms at eye level.
execution: Sweep the bar down to your thighs while keeping the arms straight.
Let it rise slowly back to eye level.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a pushdown.

en.name: Inverted Row
setup: Set a bar in a rack or Smith machine at about waist height.
Hang under it with straight arms and heels on the floor, body straight.
execution: Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower yourself until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Reaching with the chin instead of the chest.

en.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
setup: Grip the parallel handles with palms facing each other.
Hang with straight arms.
execution: Pull up until your chin is above the handles.
Lower yourself all the way down.
mistakes: Cutting the bottom of the rep short.

en.name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
setup: Grip the bar well wider than your shoulders with palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and brace.
execution: Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.
Lower under control to straight arms.
mistakes: Using a grip so wide the range becomes tiny.

en.name: Pendlay Row
setup: Set the bar on the floor and hinge until your torso is close to parallel.
Grip the bar a little wider than shoulders with a flat back.
execution: Pull the bar explosively to your lower chest.
Return it to the floor and let it settle before the next rep.
mistakes: Lifting the torso as the bar rises.
Rounding the back to reach the bar.
en.safety: Keep the back flat; this position loads the lower back heavily.

en.name: Superman
setup: Lie face down with your arms stretched overhead and legs straight.
Rest your forehead just above the floor.
execution: Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor together.
Hold for a breath, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Cranking the neck up to look forward.
Lifting by swinging rather than squeezing.

en.name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
setup: Sit with your thighs under the pad.
Grip the bar about shoulder width with palms facing you.
execution: Pull the bar to your upper chest.
Let it return until your arms are straight.

en.name: Negative Pull-Up
setup: Use a box or a jump to get your chin above the bar.
Grip with palms facing away, shoulder width.
execution: Lower yourself as slowly as you can, aiming for three to five seconds.
Step back up and repeat.
mistakes: Dropping quickly through the bottom half.
Letting the shoulders shrug up at the bottom.

en.name: Underhand Barbell Row
setup: Hold the bar with palms facing forward, hands shoulder width.
Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
execution: Row the bar to your lower belly, keeping the elbows close.
Lower until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Curling the weight with the biceps.

en.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
setup: Loop a band over the bar and put one knee or foot into it.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and hang.
execution: Pull your chin over the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Letting the band launch you at the bottom.
Using the same thick band forever.

en.name: Suspension Trainer Row
setup: Face the anchor holding a handle in each hand.
Walk your feet forward and lean back with straight arms and a straight body.
execution: Pull your chest to the handles.
Lower yourself until your arms are straight.
cues: Walk feet forward for more difficulty

en.name: Scapular Pull-Up
setup: Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Let your shoulders rise toward your ears.
execution: Without bending the arms, pull your shoulder blades down so your body rises a few centimetres.
Lower back to a relaxed hang.

en.name: Ring Row
setup: Set the rings at about waist height and grip one in each hand.
Walk your feet forward and lean back with a straight body.
execution: Pull your chest up to the rings, turning your palms in as you rise.
Lower until your arms are straight.

en.name: Close-Grip Chin-Up
setup: Grip the bar with palms facing you and hands a few centimetres apart.
Hang with straight arms.
execution: Pull up until your chin clears the bar, elbows staying in front of the body.
Lower to straight arms.

en.name: Bar Muscle-Up
setup: Grip the bar with palms facing away, slightly narrower than for a pull-up.
Hang and start a small, controlled swing.
execution: Pull explosively toward your hips, bringing the bar low on your chest.
Lean the chest over the bar as you rotate the wrists over it.
Press up to straight arms above the bar.
mistakes: Pulling straight up to the chin instead of toward the hips.
Getting one arm over before the other.
en.safety: Be able to do strict pull-ups and dips with control before you try muscle-ups.

en.name: Single-Arm Cable Row
setup: Attach a single handle to a low or mid pulley.
Sit or stand facing it and hold the handle with one arm straight.
execution: Row the handle to your side, driving the elbow back.
Let it return slowly, reaching the shoulder forward.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to move the weight.

en.name: Band Lat Pulldown
setup: Anchor a band high, such as over a door or bar.
Kneel facing it and hold the ends with straight arms overhead.
execution: Pull your hands down to your shoulders, driving the elbows to your sides.
Let your arms rise slowly.
mistakes: Letting the band snap the arms up.

en.name: Band Seated Row
setup: Sit with your legs straight and loop the band around your feet.
Hold the ends with straight arms and sit tall.
execution: Pull your hands to your waist, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Rounding the back at the start.

en.name: Seal Row
setup: Raise a flat bench on blocks so your arms hang straight without the bar touching the floor.
Lie face down with the bar below you.
execution: Pull the bar up to the underside of the bench.
Lower it until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench.
Using a bench too low for a full stretch.

en.name: Wide-Grip Seated Cable Row
setup: Attach a long straight bar to the low pulley.
Sit tall and grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
execution: Row the bar to your lower chest with the elbows flared to about 60 degrees.
Squeeze the upper back, then return slowly.
cues: Elbows wide, squeeze the upper back

en.name: Meadows Row
setup: Stand side-on to the end of a landmine bar in a staggered stance.
Hinge forward and grip the thick end of the bar with an overhand grip.
execution: Row the bar up and back toward your hip.
Lower until your arm is straight.

en.name: Kettlebell Row
setup: Stand in a split stance and rest one hand on your front thigh or a bench.
Hold a kettlebell in the other hand with your arm straight.
execution: Row the kettlebell to your hip.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight.

en.name: Back Extension Machine
setup: Adjust the machine so the pad sits across your upper back.
Fasten the belt or foot rest and sit tall.
execution: Push back against the pad by extending your spine and hips.
Return slowly to the start.

en.name: Single-Arm Kneeling Lat Pulldown
setup: Attach a handle to a high pulley and kneel facing it.
Hold the handle with one arm straight overhead.
execution: Pull the elbow down to your side.
Let the arm rise until you feel a stretch in your lat.

en.name: Stability Ball Back Extension
setup: Lie face down over a stability ball with the ball under your hips.
Brace your feet wide against a wall or the floor.
execution: Lift your chest until your body is in a straight line.
Lower slowly over the ball.
mistakes: Arching too far at the top.

en.name: Flexed-Arm Hang
setup: Stand on a box under the bar and grip it with palms facing you.
Step or jump up until your chin is above the bar.
execution: Hold the top position with your chest close to the bar.
Lower slowly when you can no longer keep your chin up.
mistakes: Letting the chin rest on the bar.

en.name: Trap Bar Shrug
setup: Stand inside the trap bar and lift it with a neutral grip.
Stand tall with arms straight.
execution: Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Hold, then lower slowly.

en.name: Cable Shrug
setup: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley.
Stand close and hold the bar in front of your thighs.
execution: Shrug straight up and pause.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Swimmer
setup: Lie face down with arms overhead and legs straight.
Lift your chest, arms and legs slightly off the floor.
execution: Lift the opposite arm and leg a little higher, then switch in a steady flutter.
Keep everything off the floor until the set ends.

en.name: Band Single-Arm Row
setup: Anchor a band at waist height.
Stand facing it in a staggered stance holding the band in one hand.
execution: Row your elbow back past your torso.
Return slowly with the arm straight.

en.name: Band Shrug
setup: Stand on the middle of a band with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the ends at your sides with straight arms.
execution: Shrug your shoulders straight up against the band.
Pause and lower slowly.

en.name: Band Straight-Arm Pulldown
setup: Anchor a band above head height.
Step back, hinge slightly and hold the band with straight arms in front of you.
execution: Sweep your hands down to your thighs.
Let them rise slowly back to eye level.

en.name: Archer Pull-Up
setup: Grip the bar very wide with palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms.
execution: Pull toward one hand while the other arm straightens along the bar.
Lower to the middle and switch sides.

en.name: Ring Muscle-Up
setup: Set the rings high and grip them with a false grip, wrists over the rings.
Hang with straight arms.
execution: Pull the rings toward your lower chest while leaning back.
Turn your chest over the rings quickly and drop into the bottom of a dip.
Press up to straight arms.
mistakes: Letting the rings drift wide during the transition.
en.safety: Learn ring dips and false-grip pull-ups first; the transition strains the elbows and shoulders.

en.name: Dip Shrug
setup: Grip the dip bars and jump up to a support with straight arms.
Bend your knees slightly and brace.
execution: Let your body sink by letting the shoulders rise toward your ears.
Push the bars down to lift your body back up, keeping the arms straight.
mistakes: Sinking so far that the shoulders hurt.
